notes:
### Settings → Notifications answers now

The panel used to sit on "Checking…" and the live focus notification never appeared. Both had the same cause: a call into Android that never came back, and no way for the app to notice. Every notification call now has a deadline and reports what happened, so the panel always ends somewhere — allowed, not allowed, or a named problem with Android's own message.

- **Asked for on open.** Elbiko now asks for notification permission when it launches, not only from that panel, and a running session appears in your shade the moment it is granted.
- **Open Android settings** from the panel. Android never asks twice, so a refusal can only be undone there — the panel re-reads the state when you come back.
- Windows and Android share this release; the desktop side carries the same fix.
